test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution'.

It is __more hot now.__
solution:
The correct answer is** option (3)** i.e. **"hotter now".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"more hot now__**" is grammatically incorrect. It should be **"hotter now."**
 
• **‘hot’** is an adjective. It has three degrees. **Hot** (positive), **Hotter **(comparative) and **Hottest **(superlative).
 
• The adjectives that have comparative forms **do not need to add ‘more’ before them.**
 __
 
• **For example: Better (CORRECT), More good (INCORRECT), Quicker (CORRECT), More quick (INCORRECT).**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "hotter now".

Therefore the correct sentence is " It is hotter now__". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The adjectives that do not have any comparative forms** need to add ‘more’ before them.** Generally, adjectives with two or more than two syllables take more before them.

 
 
• **For example: Beautiful- More beautiful**. **Boring- More boring. **
